digest.component_or_area: LLM structured parsing — reask retry loop failure artifact capture
propositions: When structured parsing fails after exhausting OUTPUT_RETRIES in the prompted reask loop of _pai_structured, the raw reply text is discarded and the failure is not replayable.

A new optional config key llm.parse_failure_artifact_dir (default None, unset=off) enables opt-in local capture of the final failed reply along with model id, contract name, and attempt count to a timestamped file, with the artifact path appended to the raised error message.

The parse_failure_artifact_dir field is added to LLMConfig in src/rebar/llm/config.py and resolved via _llm_str in from_env following the standard RESERVED-section pattern, without touching core src/rebar/config.py.

The artifact write hook is best-effort and confined to the _pai_structured prompted branch only; any I/O error is swallowed and the original parse error is raised unchanged, so the debugging aid never masks the root failure.
The artifact directory is auto-created if absent and pruned to retain at most 20 newest artifacts by mtime per directory, preventing unbounded growth on unattended hosts.
